decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The  extension is acceptable due to its position, design and appearance. The development does not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The flank wall and splay facing No.1 Willow Gardens shall be finished in solid panels within six months of the date of this permission and retained as such and shall not be replaced otherwise without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of single storey conservatory to rear of house.
